checks.comment: replace with a real check: id names the gate, count = observed rows/files/commands
honestly-failed checks stay in checks[] with passed=false; they also get an errors[] row. Never omit a failing check to make the receipt read clean.

commands.comment: every command that produced this receipt, with its real exit code

replay.comment: replay pair = verify.py run twice, byte-identical output both times; set status only after witnessing it

nonclaims: slice ALIVE (no real gate output witnessed)
